question.worked_solution:
Notice that the given series is a geometric series because it is in the form $\sum a{r}^{n}.$ 

The sum to infinity ${S}_{\infty }$ of a geometric series is given by the formula

$$
{S}_{\infty }=\frac{{a}_{1}}{1-r},\,|r|<1,
$$

where ${a}_{1}$ is the first term and $r$ is the common ratio.

The first term is

$$
{a}_{1}=\frac{5}{2}{(0.4)}^{1}=1.
$$

 

The common ratio is

$$
r=\frac{{a}_{2}}{{a}_{1}}=\frac{\frac{5}{2}{(0.4)}^{2}}{\frac{5}{2}{(0.4)}^{1}}=0.4.
$$

So, the sum of the series is

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }\frac{5}{2}{(0.4)}^{n} & =\frac{{a}_{1}}{1-r} \\  & =\frac{1}{1-0.4} \\  & =\frac{1}{0.6} \\  & =\frac{10}{6} \\  & =\frac{5}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
